# parallelSubstitutionTest.py

You can view and download this file on Github: [parallelSubstitutionTest.py](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/tree/master/python/TestModels/parallelSubstitutionTest.py)

```{code-block} python
:linenos:

#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
# This is an EXUDYN example
#
# Details:  exu.special.solver.parallelSubstitution (#3432): EigenSparse with a nested-dissection ordering and the
#           forward and backward substitution by the subtrees of the ordering on the threads. A chain of 40 rigid
#           bodies on revolute joints (index 3, with zero diagonals of the multipliers and of an Euler parameter) and
#           a chain of 200 mass points on springs (an ODE system) are solved with modified and with full Newton on 1
#           and 4 threads and compared with EigenSparse; special.solver.parallelSubstitutionSerial counts the
#           factorizations whose substitution could not run by subtrees, which must stay 0 here. Run alone, it shows
#           the chain of rigid bodies in the SolutionViewer.
#
# Author:   Johannes Gerstmayr
# Date:     2026-11-11
#
# Copyright:This file is part of Exudyn. Exudyn is free software. You can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the Exudyn license. See 'LICENSE.txt' for more details.
#
#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

import exudyn as exu
from exudyn.utilities import * #includes itemInterface and rigidBodyUtilities
import exudyn.graphics as graphics
import numpy as np
from exudyn import cMath #the math functions of the C++ code, the same bits on every platform
testIsActive = exu.sys.get('testIsActive', False) #run alone: the solution file and the SolutionViewer

errors = 0 #the number of failed checks

def Check(condition, text):
    global errors
    if not condition:
        errors += 1
        exu.Print('parallelSubstitutionTest: FAILED:', text)

def Solve(kind, parallel, numberOfThreads=1, modifiedNewton=True, show=False):
    """the position of the last body after 0.2 s"""
    SC = exu.SystemContainer()
    mbs = SC.AddSystem()
    previous = mbs.CreateGround()
    L = 0.5
    n = 40 if kind == 'revolute' else 200
    for i in range(n):
        if kind == 'revolute':
            body = mbs.CreateRigidBody(referencePosition=[L*(i+0.5), 0, 0], inertia=InertiaCuboid(1000, [L, 0.05, 0.05]),
                                       gravity=[0, -9.81, 0],
                                       graphicsDataList=[graphics.Brick(size=[L, 0.05, 0.05], color=graphics.color.steelblue)])
            mbs.CreateRevoluteJoint(itemNumbers=[previous, body], position=[L*i, 0, 0], axis=[0, 0, 1],
                                    axisRadius=0.02, axisLength=0.08)
        else:
            body = mbs.CreateMassPoint(referencePosition=[L*(i+1), 0, 0], mass=1, gravity=[0, -9.81, 0],
                                       graphicsDataList=[graphics.Sphere(radius=0.05, color=graphics.color.red)])
            mbs.CreateSpringDamper(itemNumbers=[previous, body], stiffness=1e4, damping=10)
        previous = body
    sensor = mbs.AddSensor(SensorBody(bodyNumber=previous, storeInternal=True, outputVariableType=exu.OutputVariableType.Position))
    mbs.Assemble()

    simulationSettings = exu.SimulationSettings()
    simulationSettings.timeIntegration.numberOfSteps = 200
    simulationSettings.timeIntegration.endTime = 0.2
    simulationSettings.timeIntegration.verboseMode = 0
    simulationSettings.timeIntegration.newton.useModifiedNewton = modifiedNewton
    simulationSettings.linearSolver.solverType = exu.LinearSolverType.EigenSparse
    simulationSettings.parallel.numberOfThreads = numberOfThreads
    simulationSettings.solution.file.write = show
    simulationSettings.solution.sensors.writePeriod = 0.2
    exu.special.solver.parallelSubstitution = parallel
    try:
        mbs.SolveDynamic(simulationSettings)
    finally:
        exu.special.solver.parallelSubstitution = False
    if show:
        mbs.SolutionViewer()
    return np.array(mbs.GetSensorValues(sensor))

special = exu.special.solver
serialBefore = special.parallelSubstitutionSerial
reference = {}
for kind in ['revolute', 'springs']:
    for modifiedNewton in [True, False]:
        reference[kind] = Solve(kind, False, modifiedNewton=modifiedNewton)
        for numberOfThreads in [1, 4]:
            position = Solve(kind, True, numberOfThreads, modifiedNewton)
            Check(cMath.norm(position - reference[kind]) < 1e-10, kind + ', modified Newton ' + str(modifiedNewton) + ', ' +
                  str(numberOfThreads) + ' threads: parallelSubstitution against EigenSparse')
Check(special.parallelSubstitutionSerial == serialBefore, 'all substitutions by subtrees')
exu.Print('parallelSubstitutionTest: reference positions', reference)

if not testIsActive:
    Solve('revolute', True, 4, show=True)

u = float(sum(reference['revolute']) + sum(reference['springs'])) + errors
exu.Print('parallelSubstitutionTest: failed checks:', errors)
exu.Print('solution of parallelSubstitutionTest=', u)
exu.sys['testResult'] = u
```
